changes.comment: Rework the diagnostic registry per PR review: diagnostic codes now use the distinctive RDC_ prefix enforced at compile time by template-literal type arithmetic (replacing runtime regex validation); message templates moved out of the registry into one module per diagnostic under diagnostics/codes/ with a defineRushDiagnostic authoring helper that derives resource keys; IRushRemediationAction gains an optional promptKey so a remediation can propagate as a prompt to an agent or user; createRushDiagnostic now accepts the union of registered codes and falls back to definition-level default remediation
